title: 第489章 前往九州第488章 中品原石
content_zh:
三日后，清晨。
韩林独坐在院子里面饮茶，同时等待着叶见春的到来。
片刻后，一阵破空声忽然响起，紧接着就见两道流光从天而降。
除了叶见春之外，来的还有另外一名大腹便便的中年男子。
“黄道友，看起来挺悠闲啊。”叶见春笑呵呵地上前。
“叶道友好，这位是……”韩林笑着招呼，同时望向那位微胖的中年。
“黄道友，我名叶大富，是叶家藏宝库的负责人，听闻你要出售灵符，所以特意跟随三爷过来的。”微胖的中年笑呵呵道。
“原来是叶大富道友，幸会幸会！”韩林见状连忙抱拳见礼，随后邀请对方落座。
叶大富表面笑呵呵，但其实是个急性子，坐下后也不废话，就问韩林灵符的事情。
韩林见对方如此着急，于是就将自己所绘的六百张逍遥符，以及十张灵风符全部取出，递给叶大富。
见韩林一次拿出这么多灵符，叶见春和叶大富都大吃了一惊。
“这家伙符道天赋竟然这般恐怖，看来得改变一下策略，等他回来，就破格提拔，直接将他升为正式客卿了。”叶见春目光轻轻闪动，在心里暗暗想道。
“黄道友，你这些灵符看起来都很不错！除了这十张灵风符我给你五十五颗灵石单价外，其他的都以七十灵石回收，你看如何？”叶大富检查了一下，有些兴奋道。
这个价格虽然不如直接卖给散修高，但也能省下不少事。
散修的需求量是有限的！自己拿去兜售，还不知道什么时候才能把这批灵符卖完。
所以韩林在听到这个价格后，只是故作犹豫了一下，就答应了下来。
最终，两种灵符合计在一起，共卖了四万两千多中品灵石。
叶大富得了灵符，本来还想跟韩林聊聊，但叶见春却表示有事情想跟韩林单独谈谈，他只好先行离开。
叶大富走后，叶见春直接道：“黄道友，上次我跟你说的事情，你做好准备没？如果没意见就跟我走吧，青锋他早已等不及了。”
“叶道友，我考虑了一下，此去异地人生路不熟，以我的修为恐怕还是不太保险，要不你再请一个帮手，与我轮流保护青锋兄弟？这样或许更加稳妥一些。”韩林试探着说道。

其实他是为了自己考虑，此番回到九州，万一遇到危险，有颜童子在，也能多几分保命的希望。
“轮流保护？我何尝不想青锋更安全，不过这样一来，贡献开支可就大了！要知道这贡献是要从我私人腰包出的，我也不怕你笑话，一下付出双倍，我根本承受不起。”叶见春无奈道。
“私人腰包出？”
韩林半开玩笑道：“叶道友到时，不会连我那份也拿不出来吧？”
叶见春道：“这你放心，你那三十万，我是绝对不会差你的！”
“嘿嘿，那就好！”韩林故作松了口气，随即眼珠轻轻转动几下道：“我觉得，这神选计划对我们金丹修士来说也是不错的机缘，就算贡献低一点，只要叶道友开口，搞不好也有大把人想要过去的。”
叶见春皱眉道：“神选计划对修行者潜力要求极高，我叶家客卿修为高的不少，但要说潜力的话，还真找不出几个符合要求的。这些人就算去往九州，也不可能脱颖而出，贡献低了压根就请不动啊。”
“潜力么，无非就是年龄和修为罢了。”韩林眉梢一挑道：“你觉得颜童子怎么样？他的真实年龄估计还不到三百吧？修为却有金丹中期，就算无缘种子级，脱颖而出，估计还是不成问题的。”
“颜童子……”
content_en:
Three days later, early morning.
Han Lin sat alone in the yard drinking tea while waiting for Ye Jianchun's arrival.
A moment later, a burst of sound suddenly sounded, and then two streams of light were seen falling from the sky.
In addition to Ye Jianchun, there was another middle-aged man with a big belly.
"Fellow Daoist Huang, you look quite relaxed." Ye Jianchun stepped forward with a smile.
"Ye Dao is friendly, this is..." Han Lin greeted with a smile while looking at the fat middle-aged man.
"Fellow Daoist Huang, my name is Ye Dafu, and I am the person in charge of the Ye family's treasure house. I heard that you were going to sell the magic talismans, so I followed the third master here specially." The fat middle-aged man said with a smile.
"It turns out to be fellow Taoist Ye Dafu. Nice to meet you!" Upon seeing this, Han Lin quickly clasped his fists in greeting and then invited the other party to sit down.
Ye Dafu smiled on the surface, but in fact he was impatient. After sitting down, he didn't talk nonsense and asked Han Lin about the magic talisman.
Seeing that the other party was so anxious, Han Lin took out all the 600 Xiaoyao Talismans and ten Spirit Wind Talismans he had drawn and handed them to Ye Dafu.
Ye Jianchun and Ye Dafu were both surprised when Han Lin took out so many talismans at once.
"This guy's Talisman talent is so terrifying. It seems that we need to change our strategy. When he comes back, we will make an exception and directly promote him to an official guest minister." Ye Jianchun's eyes flickered slightly and he thought to himself.
"Fellow Daoist Huang, these spiritual talismans of yours look very good! Except for the unit price of these ten spiritual wind talismans, which I will give you fifty-five spiritual stones, the rest will be recycled at seventy spiritual stones. What do you think?" Ye Dafu checked them and said excitedly.
Although the price is not as high as selling directly to casual cultivators, it can still save a lot of trouble.
The demand for casual cultivators is limited! I'm going to sell it myself. I don't know when I can sell out this batch of talismans.
So after hearing the price, Han Lin just pretended to hesitate and agreed.
In the end, the two kinds of spiritual stones were combined and a total of more than 42,000 mid-grade spiritual stones were sold.
Ye Dafu got the magic talisman and originally wanted to talk to Han Lin, but Ye Jianchun said that he had something to talk to Han Lin alone, so he had to leave first.
After Ye Dafu left, Ye Jianchun said directly: "Fellow Daoist Huang, are you ready for what I told you last time? If you don't have any objection, just come with me. Qingfeng can't wait any longer."
"Fellow Daoist Ye, I've thought about it. I'm not familiar with life in a different place. I'm afraid it's not safe with my cultivation. How about you hire another helper to take turns protecting Brother Qingfeng with me? This may be safer." Han Lin said tentatively.
In fact, he was thinking for himself. When he returned to Kyushu this time, if he encountered danger, having Yan Tongzi around would give him a little more hope of saving his life.
"Take turns to protect? Why don't I want Qingfeng to be safer, but in this way, the contribution expenses will be huge! You must know that this contribution comes from my personal pocket, and I am not afraid of your jokes. I can't afford to pay double at once." Ye Jianchun said helplessly.
"Private pockets?"
Han Lin said half-jokingly: "When Fellow Daoist Ye arrives, he won't be able to get even my share, right?"
Ye Jianchun said: "Don't worry, I will never give you your three hundred thousand!"
"Hehe, that's good!" Han Lin pretended to be relieved, then rolled his eyes slightly and said, "I think this divine selection plan is also a good opportunity for us Jindan monks. Even if the contribution is lower, as long as Fellow Daoist Ye opens his mouth, there may be a lot of people who want to come."
Ye Jianchun frowned and said: "The Divine Selection Plan has extremely high requirements for the potential of cultivators. I, the guest of the Ye family, have a lot of high cultivation, but in terms of potential, I really can't find a few who meet the requirements. Even if these people go to Kyushu, they won't be able to stand out. If their contribution is low, they won't be hired at all."
"Potential, it's just age and cultivation." Han Lin raised his eyebrows and said, "What do you think of Yan Tongzi?His real age is estimated to be less than three hundred, right? His cultivation level is in the middle stage of Golden Core. Even if he misses the seed level, it probably won't be a problem to stand out. "
"Yan Tongzi..."
